text:
elaine-partnerships: Hey team — AWS marketplace is holding the PO because the reseller (Equinox Resellers Inc) needs delegated signatory proof from our merchant account. They say the PO must be signed by a delegated signer or accompanied by notarized proxy.

sam-legal: Ugh. Did they ask for a specific template? We usually accept a company-signed letter on letterhead + copy of gov ID.

elaine-partnerships: They forwarded: "finance requires notarized delegated authority" and a link to their portal. They also flagged mismatched signer name vs merchant account name.

aj-sales: cc @vika-finance — is there any way to provide expedited proof? Customer is ready to close.

vika-finance: We can produce a signed letter and scanned ID quickly, but notarization will add 1–2 business days if done in US. Do we have the reseller's PO contact to request acceptance of electronic apostille?

kevin-ops: Marketplace portal rejects unsigned PDFs, fyi. There's a field for signer name that must match the legal entity in their ledger.

sam-legal: Drafted a short proxy template, dropping it here. If they insist on notarization we'll need reseller to sign in front of notary. /cc @elaine-partnerships

sam-legal: ```
To whom it may concern,

[Reseller Legal Name] hereby authorizes [Authorized Signer Name], holding the position of [Title], to sign purchase orders and contractual documents on behalf of [Reseller Legal Name] for transactions with Redwood Inference.

Signed,

[Reseller Authorizing Officer]
[Title]
[Date]
``` 

elaine-partnerships: Thanks, Sam. I'll send to Equinox and ask if an electronic signature + scanned ID is acceptable to avoid notary delay. Any objection to adding line about PO limit (e.g., up to $X)?

aj-sales: Good call. Add explicit PO value cap if reseller wants it. Also ask their portal contact for an exception — sometimes partner ops can accept expedited docs.

marketplace-bot: Notice: AWS Marketplace PO ingestion failed (error code: SIGNER_MISMATCH). See https://marketplace.example.com/po/987654 for details.

vika-finance: If they need proof of merchant account ownership, we can also export account verification PDF from our payments provider. That might help.

elaine-partnerships: I'll send combined packet: (1) Sam's proxy template signed by Equinox, (2) scanned gov ID, (3) payments-verification PDF, (4) optional cap clause. Aiming to get back to them within today. If they still insist on notarization, escalate to partner ops and ask for temporary PO hold release.

aj-sales: 👍 please paste their reply here. If notarization is required we'll propose a temp MOA (memorandum of acknowledgement) so service can start.

sam-legal: If notarization ends up mandatory, we'll prepare language that limits liability and covers the notarization window. Keep me posted.

elaine-partnerships: Will do. Filing as thread—thanks everyone :pray:
